record.paper_title: Open problems on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
record.context_brief: existence for prescribed H and planar boundary
record.original_question: Let C be a simple closed planar curve of length L bounding a planar domain D. For every H in the interval [0, L/(2|D|)], does there exist a constant-mean-curvature H-surface with boundary C? What can be proved in the special cases where C is convex or where C is an ellipse?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1. Let C be a simple planar closed curve. Is there an H-surface bounded by C for each H of the interval [0,L/(2|D|)]? Particularize to the case that C is a convex curve or C is an ellipse.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a simple closed curve contained in a plane $\Pi$, of length $L$, bounding a planar domain $D \subset \Pi$ with area $|D|$. For a real number $H$, an $H$-surface with boundary $C$ is a compact immersed surface $M \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ with constant mean curvature equal to $H$ whose boundary $\partial M$ coincides with $C$.

It is known (by an integral/flux argument applied to the planar disk filling $C$) that a necessary condition for the existence of an $H$-surface with boundary $C$ is $|H| \leq L/(2|D|)$.

(a) Prove or disprove: for every $H \in [0, L/(2|D|)]$, there exists an $H$-surface with boundary $C$.

(b) Establish what can be proved under the additional hypothesis that $C$ is a convex planar curve.

(c) Establish what can be proved in the particular case where $C$ is an ellipse.
artifact.category_tag: Constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as an open problem in recent surveys on compact constant mean curvature surfaces with boundary. While the case of a circular boundary is classical (spherical caps provide existence for all admissible H), existence of H-surfaces spanning a general planar curve—including convex curves and ellipses—for every H in the necessary range [0, L/(2|D|)] is not established in the literature found. Related results address restricted cases (circles, symmetric configurations, small H via perturbation), but the full range remains an active research question.

status_evidence.title: Surfaces with constant mean curvature in Euclidean space (Lopez survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing existence problems for CMC surfaces with prescribed planar boundary; the question for general planar curves and the full admissible range of H is highlighted as open.
status_evidence.claim: The general existence question for H-surfaces with prescribed planar boundary remains open.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature graphs in a strip of R^2
status_evidence.snippet: Studies CMC graphs over planar domains; existence depends on geometric data of the boundary.
status_evidence.claim: Partial existence results known but full range not settled for general convex curves.
